title: Quaint Creamy Korean Duck Guk
description: A sour, creamy, and cozy Korean dish featuring duck sauce and tadka, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly meal. This guk is a hearty and comforting option for any time of day.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Stir in the tadka spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the duck sauce and heavy cream, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the chopped kimchi and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the guk hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
